description: strict-delivery hooks: session context, per-prompt reminder, tool checks and read receipts. Each entry runs python3 -m gates hook from the plugin directory.

hooks.command: cd "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" && exec python3 -m gates hook SessionStart
cd "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" && exec python3 -m gates hook UserPromptSubmit
cd "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" && exec python3 -m gates hook PreToolUse
cd "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" && exec python3 -m gates hook PreToolUse
cd "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" && exec python3 -m gates hook PreToolUse
cd "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" && exec python3 -m gates hook PostToolUse
cd "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" && exec python3 -m gates hook SubagentStop
